endings.scene: Night on Bellgrave Bay after defeat. The undead fleet's torn purple banner with a broken gold crown sinks slowly beneath black water. Far out, a single small boat with a lantern rows toward the viewer through fog.
endings.power: the banner fills the foreground, half under water; the tiny lantern boat is the only point of hope, placed on the lower third; vast empty dark sea between them.
endings.light: near-black sea and sky, the lantern's cyan-green the only light, reflected in long ripples.
endings.world: This scene is far from the capital: NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky.

endings.scene: The white throne hall of Sunhold. Edmund sits on a high white-and-gold throne wearing his snapped crown; ranks of motionless undead guards line both sides; Eleanor stands far below and apart at a tall window, her back half turned.
endings.power: low camera from the hall floor looking up the long stair to the throne; Edmund small but central and elevated; the guards repeat as dark silhouettes; Eleanor isolated at the edge of the frame.
endings.light: cold pale light from the Unending Day pours through high windows in shafts; cyan rim light on the undead; the throne hall feels like a tomb.
endings.world: The capital Sunhold is lit by a second, artificial 'Unending Day': a pale, heatless ring of light hanging above the palace tower.

endings.scene: A palace guardroom at dawn. Edmund, crowned, stands in the doorway looking down a long row of empty armour stands and hooks; only Bernard remains, standing beside him by choice.
endings.power: deep one-point perspective down the empty row; two figures at the near end, small against the emptiness.
endings.light: first natural dawn light through arrow slits, mixing with the pale artificial day.
endings.world: The capital Sunhold is lit by a second, artificial 'Unending Day': a pale, heatless ring of light hanging above the palace tower.

endings.scene: Eleanor sits on the throne; Edmund stands just behind it in shadow with one hand on the throne's back; in the foreground, courtiers bow toward him, not toward her.
endings.power: the queen is in the light but the courtiers' bowed backs point to the shadowed figure behind her; Edmund's shadow falls across her.
endings.light: pale artificial day on the queen; Edmund lit only by his own cyan soulfire.
endings.world: The capital Sunhold is lit by a second, artificial 'Unending Day': a pale, heatless ring of light hanging above the palace tower.

endings.scene: Evening on a harbour wall of the white city. Edmund and Eleanor sit side by side on the warm stone; nearby Pip plays a dismissal call toward undead figures walking away down the quay; the city behind them stays lit by the artificial day although the natural sun is setting at sea.
endings.power: intimate wide shot; the siblings small against a huge sky split between the real sunset over the sea and the pale artificial glow over the city.
endings.light: two light sources in conflict: warm orange natural sunset on the sea side, cold white artificial day on the city side.
endings.world: The capital Sunhold is lit by a second, artificial 'Unending Day': a pale, heatless ring of light hanging above the palace tower.

endings.scene: Sunhold at night after the Unending Day has gone out: a real dark sky full of stars for the first time. On the docks, lines of bound undead soldiers carry grain sacks; Edmund, crowned, watches from a high stair.
endings.power: high angle from behind Edmund over the docks; the labouring lines below him like a machine; he is the only still figure.
endings.light: starlight and dock torches; cyan soulfire on every undead; no artificial day.
endings.world: The artificial Unending Day has been extinguished: there is NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky; only the natural sky.

endings.scene: A winter night in a plain market square of the white city after the Unending Day has gone out. Edmund, crowned, stands among ordinary living townsfolk handing out split firewood from a cart; braziers burn in the square; the windows around show ordinary scattered lamplight under a real starry sky. No papers, books, signs or banners anywhere.
endings.power: eye-level, crowded and human; the crown is the only gold in the scene; the king works shoulder to shoulder with commoners, a little apart because of what he is.
endings.light: warm brazier and lamplight, real night sky with stars; his soulfire subdued.
endings.world: The artificial Unending Day has been extinguished: there is NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky; only the natural night sky. There is no writing anywhere in the image.

endings.scene: A rocky shore at dusk after the first winter preparations. Eleanor and Edmund face each other on the shingle; behind him a long line of undead sentinels stands along the cliff top watching the sea.
endings.power: wide shot; the sentinels' silhouettes run the length of the cliff like a wall; the siblings small at the waterline between land and sea.
endings.light: natural violet dusk; warm rim on Eleanor, cyan on the undead.
endings.world: The artificial Unending Day has been extinguished: there is NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky; only the natural sky.

endings.scene: Eleanor on a palace balcony watches the pale artificial sun fade and go out above the white city while the natural sun sets; for the first time the sky above Sunhold darkens fully and the first stars appear. Below in the courtyard Pip raises his bugle; undead walk out freely through an open gate toward the sea.
endings.power: over-the-shoulder from behind Eleanor; the city spread below; the dying ring of light high in the sky is the focal point, with the first star beside it.
endings.light: the last of the artificial glow fading to nothing; deep blue dusk; warm orange on the horizon; the first stars.
endings.world: The artificial ring above Sunhold is fading out and almost gone in this moment.

endings.scene: The last shore at dawn on a calm grey sea. Edmund steps into the Ferryman's small boat; the Ferryman reaches toward his lantern to put it out. On the shore behind, Eleanor and a few volunteer undead watch him go.
endings.power: low wide shot from the water; the boat in the foreground; the watchers small on the shore; Edmund half-turned between the two.
endings.light: pale natural dawn breaking over the sea; the lantern the last cyan light in the image.
endings.world: This scene is far from the capital: NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky. The ONLY cyan-green light in the whole image is the small flame inside the Ferryman's lantern; Edmund's soulfire is already almost extinguished.
